units.source_text: 腊尽春来，天色明丽，汀边的冰都解冻了。

en.t: As the year ended and spring arrived, the sky was bright and clear, and the ice along the water's edge had all thawed.

units.source_text: 两女公子依然愁眉不展，自念如此悲伤，也能活到今日，真乃意外之事。

en.t: The two young ladies still wore sorrowful expressions, thinking to themselves that it was truly unexpected they had lived until this day despite such grief.

units.source_text: 阿阇梨的山寺里派人送些泽中的芹菜和山上的蕨菜来，说道是融雪之后摘得来的。

en.t: From the mountain temple of the Ajari, someone was sent to bring water parsley from the marsh and bracken from the hills, saying they had been gathered after the snow melted.

units.source_text: 侍女们便拿来做成素菜，供女公子佐膳。

en.t: The waiting women then prepared them as vegetarian dishes and served them alongside the young ladies' meal.

units.source_text: 她们说：“山乡自有风味，看到草木荣枯，知道春秋递变，也是很可喜的。”

en.t: They said, "A mountain village has its own charm; seeing the grasses and trees flourish and wither, and knowing the seasons are turning, is also something to delight in."

units.source_text: 但两女公子想：“有什么可喜呢？”

en.t: But the two young ladies thought, "What is there to delight in?"
